results.title: Rutherford, Hossain join NPL teams ahead of new season
results.content: West Indies batter Sherfane Rutherford joins Sudurpaschim Royals after scoring 291 runs for Gujarat Titans in the 2025 IPL, while Bangladesh all-rounder Shamim Hossain signs for Lumbini Lions.

results.title: Seven killed as gunmen open fire at church in Jordan in 'terrorist' attack, authorities say
results.content: Authorities blame extremists for the shooting during a funeral at a church in Karak, which also left 40 people wounded.

results.title: Modern night bus service begins between Jajarkot and Kathmandu
results.content: Six buses are operating on the route, with fares set at Rs3,500 against the government rate of Rs4,066.

results.title: Road accidents in Kathmandu Valley fall during Dashain
results.content: The number of crashes fell from 155 last year to 105 this year, while fatalities dropped from 10 to three, according to traffic police.

results.title: Ambani's Jio becomes most subscribed Indian IPO with $77 billion in bids
results.content: The offering surpasses the 2008 Reliance Power IPO, attracting more than 13.8 million applications and drawing strong demand from institutional and retail investors.

results.title: David Miller joins Karnali Yaks for third NPL season
results.content: The South African left-hander, a key player in Gujarat Titans’ 2022 IPL title win, brings extensive international and franchise T20 experience to Karnali’s squad.

results.title: Europe’s deadliest summer in 26 years leaves 50,000 dead, study estimates
results.content: Scientists estimate that fossil fuel-driven climate change contributed to about two-thirds of heat-related deaths across 854 cities in 30 European countries.

results.title: Dashain brings fewer domestic tourists to Sauraha
results.content: Hoteliers say fears of renewed road closures have kept visitors away, although international tourists are gradually returning after flood-related cancellations.

results.title: Kathmandu’s streets are filling up as Dashain winds down
results.content: People are beginning to return to the Valley ahead of Dashain’s formal conclusion at Purnima, bringing more vehicles and pedestrians back onto the roads.

results.title: Rabi Lamichhane says India visit is personal, not political
results.content: The RSP chair says he is travelling to fulfil a vow he made in prison, with visits planned to temples in Uttarakhand and Assam.

results.title: They never fought in the decade-long ‘People’s War’. They still bear its scars
results.content: Civilians injured or disabled during the conflict, despite having no affiliation with either side, say the state has excluded them from relief and compensation programmes.

results.title: Wagle asks Jaishankar whether global cooperation is shifting towards ad hoc partnerships
results.content: Nepal’s finance minister questions whether smaller, flexible groupings can replace traditional multilateral institutions or need stronger institutional backing.

results.title: The era of anti-India nationalism is over, Wagle says
results.content: Speaking in New Delhi, Nepal’s finance minister Swarnim Wagle says the new government wants closer ties with India and signals that Prime Minister Balendra Shah could visit by year-end.

results.title: Banks and government agencies take websites offline over PHP security flaws
results.content: Nepal Rastra Bank has urged financial institutions, payment operators and remittance companies to strengthen their defences after serious vulnerabilities were found in PHP, a programming language widely used to run websites.

results.title: What’s new in the Nepal Premier League’s third season?
results.content: DRS, ICC sanction, international stars and upgraded stadium facilities mark the tournament’s return to Kirtipur on October 26.

results.title: Nepal takes government websites offline over critical PHP flaws
results.content: Emergency patching is underway after two vulnerabilities exposed systems worldwide to attacks that could allow hackers to run code on servers without logging in.

results.title: Hacking attempts surge as firms race to patch PHP flaws
results.content: Cloud providers report millions of hacking attempts as governments and companies rush to secure systems and temporarily suspend online services.

results.title: Earthquake of magnitude 7 strikes China’s Tibet, killing 16
results.content: The quake struck a sparsely populated, high-altitude area of northern Tibet, injuring 32 people and prompting rescue teams to mobilise.

results.title: Loss and damage fund approves $20 million for Nepal
results.content: The funding is intended to help flood-hit communities in the Bhotekoshi–Trishuli region recover and rebuild.

results.title: Van Schalkwyk, Mathews join NPL squads
results.content: Lumbini Lions sign the US all-rounder after his 13-wicket haul at the T20 World Cup, while Biratnagar Kings bolster their line-up with the former Sri Lankan captain.

results.title: Fungal disease threatens rice harvest in Palpa
results.content: Farmers report yield losses of 15 to 20 percent as the disease spreads through paddy fields, with symptoms appearing after the plants develop panicles.

results.title: Nepal says it is saddened by the killing of its citizen in Saudi oil field attack
results.content: The Foreign Ministry said Nepal reiterates its unequivocal condemnation of all attacks targeted at civilians and critical infrastructure.

results.title: Pakistan all-rounder Hussain Talat joins Karnali Yaks
results.content: The 30-year-old, who has represented Pakistan in ODIs and T20 internationals, brings franchise experience from the PSL and BPL to the Nepal Premier League.

results.title: Madhyapur Thimi celebrates its Malla-era battle tradition
results.content: Observed annually on the 11th day of Dashain, the ‘Kha: Pihanwaigu’ festival features a procession with traditional weapons and ceremonial armour, followed by a ritual believed to protect households from illness.

results.title: Deepa Nepali’s 186-day protest goes unheard as government stays silent
results.content: The activist spent Dashain at Maitighar Mandala, demanding action against caste-based discrimination and the exclusion of Dalits from rented accommodation.

results.title: A Nepali among eight injured in Dammam airport attack
results.content: The airport attack came hours after falling debris from a drone intercepted by Saudi air defences near a processing facility at Aramco’s Shaybah oil field killed a Nepali and a Filipino worker and injured two others.

results.title: What is PHP, and why are security flaws putting European government websites at risk?
results.content: Two critical flaws could let hackers take control of vulnerable servers, prompting warnings to patch systems or take websites offline.

results.title: Scrub typhus death toll reaches ten in Salyan
results.content: The district has recorded 817 infections, with Darma Rural Municipality reporting the highest number of cases.

results.title: Kathmandu to host Cricket World Cup Qualifier Play-Off in December
results.content: Eight teams will compete for four places in the 2027 ICC Men’s Cricket World Cup Qualifier, with Nepal, the UAE, Namibia and Canada among the participants.

results.title: Two killed in motorcycle crash in Arghakhanchi
results.content: The motorcycle crashed in Bhumikasthan Municipality-2 on Wednesday night, killing the father and son at the scene.

results.title: ICC recognises Nepal Premier League matches as List A T20 fixtures
results.content: The recognition means performances in the October 26-November 21 tournament will count towards official T20 statistics.

results.title: Putin agrees to resume 3-way peace talks with Ukraine and US
results.content: The Kremlin says the next round of US-mediated talks could begin in November, but Moscow and Kyiv remain far apart on territorial concessions, security guarantees and the terms of a peace deal.

results.title: After Nepal’s recent disaster, it wants to test whether COP31 can deliver climate justice
results.content: Nepal has made an emergency appeal to the UN’s loss-and-damage fund, which has yet to disburse any money. Meanwhile, families wait for relief, and the country takes on more loans to rebuild.

results.title: Nepali worker killed in drone attack on Saudi Aramco oil field
results.content: A Filipino national was also killed, while a Pakistani and an Indian worker were injured, Saudi Arabia’s energy ministry says.

results.title: Dashain just isn’t the same in this village anymore
results.content: In Dadeldhura’s Kafali, families have dwindled from 17 to six as people leave in search of better services and livelihoods, leaving behind empty homes and fading festival traditions.

results.title: Nepal to host 15 matches at 2027 Under-19 Women’s T20 World Cup
results.content: The 16-team tournament will run for 17 days, with Kathmandu hosting Nepal’s group-stage matches against Ireland, India and West Indies.

results.title: How cheap Chinese antibiotics threaten Europe's last major penicillin plant
results.content: Cheap Chinese supplies threaten Europe’s last penicillin plant, raising fears of drug shortages and dependence on imports.

results.title: Foreign tourists join Dashain celebrations in Thamel
results.content: Visitors at a Kathmandu hotel receive tika and jamara on Bijaya Dashami, embracing one of Nepal’s biggest festivals and its cultural traditions.

results.title: Five detained for allegedly allowing Nepalis to gamble at Parsa casino
results.content: Nepali law bars citizens from entering casinos and gambling, but police say the facility was allowing them to do so.

results.title: Even on Dashain, some Nepalis leave their families behind in search of a better future abroad
results.content: After celebrating the festival with loved ones, migrant workers head to the airport with tika and jamara on their foreheads, bound for jobs and opportunities overseas.
